follow-up time: From admission in labor until the end of delivery
cohort: Pregnant women admitted to Irene Neto Maternity Hospital, Lubango city, Huíla province, Angola (n = 500)
finding: This study identified characteristics associated with a higher risk of adverse pregnancy outcomes among pregnant women in Huíla province, Angola, including adolescence, illiteracy, and short stature, and highlighted birth asphyxia and low birth weight as newborn outcomes requiring special attention.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was performed in 25.2% of the women, although there was no medical indication for 23.0% of women having cesareans.
